all.headline: Iran vows retaliation after deadly US strike on bridge in Karaj
all.description: Iranian officials say the country’s largest bridge will be “built back stronger,” but America’s standing won't recover.

all.headline: Trump unveils 100 percent tariff on drugs to push for pharmaceutical deals
all.description: US president has said that he will use tariffs to bring down costly medical drugs, but the impact remains uncertain.

all.headline: US court orders resentencing for Colorado clerk involved in election scheme
all.description: Former clerk Tina Peters has become a cause celebre for the election denial movement and President Donald Trump.

all.headline: Rights groups, Milwaukee leaders slam ICE’s arrest of Palestinian advocate
all.description: Salah Sarsour, the president of Islamic Society of Milwaukee, was reportedly detained while driving on March 30.

all.headline: Unbridled Bosnian joy marks World Cup qualification win over Italy
all.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina's dramatic win over Italy sparks wild celebrations from Zenica to Sarajevo and evokes memories.

all.headline: Pope Leo condemns ‘brutality’ of world in first Easter services
all.description: Pope Leo washed the feet of 12 priests in a ritual, using the moment to urge Catholics to stand with the oppressed.

all.headline: 9-year-old boy recounts airstrike in Lebanon that killed whole family
all.description: Karim Al-Haj Hussein survived an Israeli strike on his home in Lebanon’s Baalbek that killed his family members.

all.headline: Oil shock triggers global price spikes as Iran war drags on
all.description: Fuel shocks from the US-Israel war on Iran are rippling worldwide, as Strait of Hormuz disruptions push prices higher.

all.headline: Iran says army forces are ready to repel US-Israeli attacks
all.description: Iran says it is ready to counter any US-Israeli attacks, insisting its military capabilities remain intact.

all.headline: Russia sending second ship with oil to Cuba amid US blockade
all.description: Announcement comes days after Russian tanker brought some 700,000 barrels of crude to Cuba in response to energy crisis.

all.description: Ordinary people from various parts of Iran describe expanding strikes, economic pain and fear of repression.

all.headline: Iran's focus on survival means same regime still firmly in place
all.description: Tehran is showing resilience despite Trump's claims of regime change, writes BBC Persian editor Amir Azimi.

all.headline: Iran's two largest steel plants shut down due to air strikes, companies say
all.description: The strikes, which Iran says were first launched by Israel in co-ordination with the US last week, could cause major damage to the Iranian economy.

all.headline: 'Be serious... don't speak every day': Macron criticises Trump approach to Iran war
all.description: The comments were an apparent jab at the US leader's sometimes contradictory stance on the US-Israeli war against Iran.

all.headline: Trump leaves key questions unanswered as he seeks to calm nerves over Iran war
all.description: There were some glaring omissions in the US president's primetime address, writes the BBC's Gary O'Donoghue.

all.headline: Iranian Nobel laureate suffered suspected heart attack in prison, family says
all.description: Narges Mohammadi's brother says he fears her life is in imminent danger and she needs to be transferred to a hospital.

all.headline: UK and allies discuss sanctions to stop Iran blocking Strait of Hormuz
all.description: Yvette Cooper said coordinated diplomatic and economic measures are required to reopen the shipping lane.

all.headline: Trump says Iran war objectives 'nearing completion' in address to nation
all.description: The US president's first televised address of the conflict with Iran did little to quell uneasy markets.

all.headline: Israel's perpetual war with Iran may be hard to win with military might alone
all.description: The war with Iran has not yet resolved any of Israel's regional conflicts in the way its prime minister suggested it would.

all.headline: Israel intensifies Lebanon attacks and hits areas not in Hezbollah's control
all.description: Attacks have continued as Israel has announced its intention to control swathes of south Lebanon.
